rate_plan.name: G3 10MB Dynamic Data Pool
rate_plan.overage_assessment: flat rate per MB, assessed against the SIM's aggregate pool balance (sum of included data across all SIMs in the pool) at month-end
migration_notes: G1 SIMs are migrated to the G3 profile at no cost to Customer where migration succeeds.
SIMs that fail migration remain on a Hologram standard plan at standard rates -- the specific standard rate is NOT itemized in this order form. See SECTION_C (ambiguity #4).
G3-G1 SIMs that have the G1 profile removed lose outage protection -- worth a proactive customer note, not just a billing note.

G3-F.frequency_assumption: one-time, at purchase/shipment -- the order form does not label a frequency for hardware the way it labels MRC 'Monthly' and overage 'Pay as you go'. Treated as one-time. See SECTION_C (ambiguity #3).
G3-F.counts_toward_minimum_spend_source: Order form explicitly excludes 'SIM card purchases' from Actual Spend.

test_mode.transition_rule: SIM moves from TEST_MODE to ACTIVE on whichever of the three conditions is met FIRST: 90 days elapsed, 100KB data consumed, or 10 outbound SMS sent.
test_mode.post_transition_behavior: Once ACTIVE, the SIM begins incurring MRC and data usage (pool contribution + overage) charges. Contract does not state whether the first month is pro-rated for a mid-month transition. See SECTION_C (ambiguity #2).

minimum_spend_schedule.note: Contract text overlaps month 12 with the prior tier. This config resolves the overlap by matching tiers in listed order (first match wins), so month 12 is treated as $600/month, not $1200/month. This is a documented assumption, not a silent guess -- see SECTION_C (ambiguity #1).
Open-ended: applies to month 25 onward, including renewal terms, until superseded by a new order form.

minimum_spend_rules.comparison: Customer pays the greater of the period's Minimum Spend Amount or their actual qualifying fees.
minimum_spend_rules.overage_carryover_rule: Fees in excess of the minimum in one period do NOT carry forward or offset future periods.
minimum_spend_rules.renewal_behavior: At each renewal, the minimum spend resets to the amount in effect during the LAST spend period of the immediately prior term -- i.e., the Year 4 renewal opens at $2,400/month, flat, not re-tiered from $3/month.
